mapper.select: SELECT database_name FROM datasource_config WHERE id = #{datasourceId}

SELECT kcu.TABLE_NAME AS source_table, kcu.COLUMN_NAME AS source_column, kcu.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME AS target_table, kcu.REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME AS target_column, rc.UPDATE_RULE, rc.DELETE_RULE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS rc ON kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME = rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA = #{schemaName} AND kcu.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO table_relationships ( datasource_id, source_table, source_column, target_table, target_column, relationship_type, confidence, description, is_active, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{datasourceId}, #{sourceTable}, #{sourceColumn}, #{targetTable}, #{targetColumn}, #{relationshipType}, #{confidence}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{createdBy}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO table_relationships ( datasource_id, source_table, source_column, target_table, target_column, relationship_type, confidence, description, is_active, created_by, created_at ) VALUES
( #{rel.datasourceId}, #{rel.sourceTable}, #{rel.sourceColumn}, #{rel.targetTable}, #{rel.targetColumn}, #{rel.relationshipType}, #{rel.confidence}, #{rel.description}, #{rel.isActive}, #{rel.createdBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE table_relationships SET source_table = #{sourceTable}, source_column = #{sourceColumn}, target_table = #{targetTable}, target_column = #{targetColumn}, relationship_type = #{relationshipType}, confidence = #{confidence}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE table_relationships SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
